cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_SDVEC() BEGIN LOCAL R:=stddev([0,1,3],{2,-.5,1}); RETURN {TYPE(R/2),ROUND(R/2,10),ROUND(2/3,10),ROUND(stddev({1,3},{.5,1.5}),10)}; END;
